meta.source: Cure patient app palette (src/theme/palette.ts, colors.ts), Cure logo, Cure Home hero film v1 — 2026-10-21

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page/screen ground behind the aurora. Never put text directly on it; use glass.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Inner screen ground of the device, under the aurora and face orb.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Aurora core and large quiet areas (Ambient background).

tokens.name: aurora-blue
tokens.usage: Largest aurora blob (radial gradient, drifts ≤0.2 Hz). Decorative only.

tokens.name: aurora-teal
tokens.usage: Second aurora blob. Decorative only.

tokens.name: aurora-lime
tokens.usage: Faint third aurora blob near the bottom edge. Decorative only.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Card glass fill (VitalCard, dock pills, ambient cards). `text`, `text-2`, `text-3` pass 4.5:1 on it over `canvas`.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, any glass holding long text; top stop of the card gradient.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on every glass or solid surface; orb ring track.

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: Inset top highlight and the specular sheen at a surface's top-left.

tokens.name: card-solid
tokens.usage: Clear view (accessibility) and low-power surfaces instead of glass.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind z2 sheets and over bright camera backdrops.

tokens.name: orbit-line
tokens.usage: Orbit ellipses and chart grid lines.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Values, headings, button labels on glass and solid surfaces (≥12:1 on glass).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and greeting subtitle on glass and solid surfaces (≥8:1).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Meta lines (reading age, source) on glass and solid surfaces (≥5.5:1). Never smaller than the `meta` style.

tokens.name: cure-blue
tokens.usage: Brand identity colour (logo cross, boot ring end, recognition arc). Only 3.7:1 on white: large text, icons and fills only in `day`.

tokens.name: cure-green
tokens.usage: Confirmation: recognised ring, taken/saved ticks, camera-on dot. Text-safe on glass in both themes.

tokens.name: cure-lime
tokens.usage: Thin accent only: boot ring start, orbit marker. Never text in `day` (2.7:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and links.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on `action` fills (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: confirm
tokens.usage: 'Mark as taken', 'Save' and other positive confirmation buttons.

tokens.name: on-confirm
tokens.usage: Label on `confirm` (≥5:1).

tokens.name: danger-action
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons (Forget me, Remove device) after a confirmation step.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on `danger-action`.

tokens.name: vital-weight
tokens.usage: Weight card: icon dot, sparkline, connector. Identity, not status.

tokens.name: vital-bp
tokens.usage: Blood-pressure card identity colour.

tokens.name: vital-sugar
tokens.usage: Glucose card identity colour.

tokens.name: vital-pulse
tokens.usage: Heart-rate card identity colour; heartbeat dot.

tokens.name: vital-spo2
tokens.usage: SpO₂ card identity colour.

tokens.name: vital-temp
tokens.usage: Temperature card identity colour.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Within the doctor's target: chip border/dot. Always with ● and words.

tokens.name: status-good-text
tokens.usage: Text on `status-good-bg` (≥7:1).

tokens.name: status-good-bg
tokens.usage: Chip fill for within-target.

tokens.name: status-watch
tokens.usage: Above or below the doctor's target: chip border/dot. Always with ▲ and words.

tokens.name: status-watch-text
tokens.usage: Text on `status-watch-bg` (≥6.8:1).

tokens.name: status-watch-bg
tokens.usage: Chip fill for outside-target.

tokens.name: status-attention
tokens.usage: Clinician-defined 'talk to your doctor' level only. Always with ! and the fixed escalation text.

tokens.name: status-attention-text
tokens.usage: Text on `status-attention-bg`.

tokens.name: status-attention-bg
tokens.usage: Chip and banner fill for attention.

tokens.name: status-unknown
tokens.usage: Implausible or unverified reading ('? Check this reading').

tokens.name: status-unknown-text
tokens.usage: Text on `status-unknown-bg`.

tokens.name: status-unknown-bg
tokens.usage: Chip fill for check-this-reading.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px solid focus ring with 3px offset on every focusable control (≥3:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: brand-disc
tokens.usage: White disc behind the full-colour Cure logo on dark grounds.

families.display: "Sora", "Noto Sans Sinhala", "Noto Sans Tamil", system-ui, sans-serif
families.ui: "Manrope", "Noto Sans Sinhala", "Noto Sans Tamil", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: value-xl
styles.usage: Vital detail hero number and measurement results.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: VitalCard value (48 px minimum for vital numbers).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Sit back and relax your arm.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: After breakfast · prescribed by Dr N. Perera
styles.usage: Default reading text; the minimum for sentences.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Reading age and source; status bar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Card labels, set in uppercase (English only; never uppercase Sinhala/Tamil).

styles.name: si-greeting
styles.usage: Greeting when the member's language is Sinhala.

styles.name: ta-greeting
styles.usage: Greeting when the member's language is Tamil.

styles.name: serif-accent
styles.usage: Second half of film captions and print headlines. Not on the device.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Film and web eyebrows, clinician data tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label row gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between touch targets; concentric inset (card 28 → inner 16).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Status bar and dock inset from the screen edge; sheet section gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Safe margin from every screen edge; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major regions on Ambient.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target size.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Ambient clock offset from the left edge.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Chips' containers, icon tiles and inner panels inside a card (card 28 − 12 padding).

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: Device screen corners (bezel).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: VitalCard, MedicineCard, VisitCard, WeatherCard.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs (z2).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Dock pills, buttons, chips, avatars, face orb.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: z1 surfaces: cards, dock pills.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: z2 sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-orb
tokens.usage: Face orb halo.

blur.note: CSS backdrop-filter blur radii. Never over live video; at most 3 blurred surfaces per screen on the Pi, never above 16px.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted cards, dock pills and sheets (screens without video).

tokens.name: opacity-dimmed
tokens.usage: Orbit cards behind an open sheet.

tokens.name: opacity-stale
tokens.usage: Connectors and hotspots for readings older than 7 days.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (≈11 mm on the 10.1-inch panel at 1.5×).

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action height.

tokens.name: orb-size
tokens.usage: Face orb diameter in Orbit View.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: VitalCard width.

tokens.name: card-height
tokens.usage: VitalCard height.

duration.note: Motion durations (used by Motion for React and anime.js through these CSS variables).

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles; Calm-motion cross-fades.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Most transitions.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Scene changes, card pulse when a reading lands.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets sliding up 50px.

tokens.name: dur-hero
tokens.usage: Orbit entrance, greeting.

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Entrances and sheets.

tokens.name: ease-out-back
tokens.usage: Cards joining the orbit, badges (overshoot ≈ back 1.4).

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything else (same as the Cure web app).
